regime_context: Banks hold a decisive one-narrative lead over Coal with high durability (0.87) and broad breadth (0.94) but are heavily crowded (z=1.98). Only Banks and Coal are trend-gate eligible, and the rotation breadth is narrow at 9%. This is a low-conviction regime: the validated drawdown gate did not hold on this market's history, momentum rank-IC is ~0, and the AI's own directional accuracy (0.337) is below chance.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Coal's mean-revert tag flips to trend and its breadth expands above 0.6 — the observable condition that would retire this watch is Coal climbing above a 0.6 breadth floor while Banks' durability_bar drops below 0.80.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the only durable (0.87), broad (0.94 breadth) trend-eligible theme in a tape otherwise dominated by ineligible mean-reverting or broken trends. The one-narrative flag (0.94 breadth, one_narrative=true) confirms leadership is real, not a statistical artifact. However the crowding_z=1.98 means this is a size-down-tilt-the-still-valid-leader, not a chase — and gate_helps=false means the discipline itself has no validated drawdown edge here.
theses.dissent: Crowding at z=1.98 in a mean-reverting A-share tape with gate_helps=false means the leader has historically been the site of sharp reversals; a crowded one-narrative leader is where reflexivity breaks down, and the agent's dir_accuracy of 0.337 is worse than a coin flip.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS lags the CSI 300 by 5% over any rolling 10-day window before the 30-day check-by

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is rank 2 but is the weakest rank-2 in a broken tape: hurst_tag=mean-revert indicates the absolute trend gate has classified it as mean-reverting (not trending), and breadth of only 0.20 shows leadership is extremely narrow — a one-security story, not a theme. Rotation margin over Banks (0.071) is not enough to flag a confirmed handoff, and the system explicitly forbids predicting the next narrative.
theses.dissent: Coal is the ONLY other trend-eligible name, and its 0.887 score is close to Banks; a mean-revert tag can reset to trend quickly if coal prices break out on China industrial restocking.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS makes a new 60-day high with breadth expanding above 0.6 and hurst tag flipping to trend before the 21-day check-by

theses.subject: Baijiu / Liquor
theses.thesis: Baijiu is in the top-4 but ineligible (score 0.28) and trend-health is degrading: high breadth (0.857) but no gate eligibility and a falling durability bar (0.58) relative to the leader. It is neither a confirmed rotation challenger (Coal holds that slot) nor a durable leader — a legacy consumer theme with a fading trend tag in a market that means-reverts.
theses.dissent: Baijiu breadth (0.857) is nearly as wide as Banks; if domestic consumption surprises on policy stimulus, the ineligible trend could re-accelerate and the rank-4 score is a lagging artifact.

falsifier.text: 512690.SS regains trend-gate eligibility and its durability_bar rises above 0.70 before the 30-day check-by
